Davco Tile & Grout Cleaner is a specially formulated to clean tough dirt and stains from tiles and grout. Davco Tile & Grout Cleaner can be used to remove minor Efflorscence.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
s: Davco Tile & Grout Cleaner is suitable for most common tiled surfaces.
Davco Tile & Grout Cleaner can remove minor Efflorescence from grout surfaces.
Removes tough dirt and stains from tiles and aged grout and helps remove mould and mildew from grout surfaces.
tr: Suitable for most types of tiles including; ceramic, porcelain, mosaic, quarry and slate tiles

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Mixing
s: Add Tile & Grout Cleaner to a clean plastic bucket and dilute with water at a ratio of 10 parts water to 1 part Tile & Grout Cleaner (5L of water to 500ml Tile & Grout Cleaner).

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Application
s: 1. Always use a saturated mop or sponge to wet down the surface with clean water before applying product
1. For normal cleaning, dampen a mop or sponge with the solution and wipe over the surface before rinsing immediately with clean warm water.

2. . For heavily soiled areas apply a greater quantity of the solution. Allow the affected area to soak for up to 10 minutes and then scrub with a stiff nylon brush before rinsing well with clean warm water.
Test product in an inconspicuous area first - 1. Place 2-3 drops on the tile. 2. Wait 15 minutes. 3. Rinse well and examine when dry to determine if the product is suitable for use.
Avoid prolonged contact and always rinse the area with clean, warm water
All tools and containers should be plastic. Do not use with metal
Avoid splashing or spilling on surrounding areas
Do not use on polished marble, limestone or metallic glazed tiles. Always conduct a test patch before use to determine product suitability
Do not use with any other detergents or cleaning materials
For other uses not mentioned in these instructions, please contact Sika Australia
